items.raw_excerpt: Aviso laranja de perigo para baixa umidade relativa do ar, de até 12%, permanece ativo para uma área que alcança 11 estados.
items.summary_en: An orange warning for dangerously low humidity levels remains active across parts of central Brazil. The drought conditions are affecting a wide area that spans 11 states. Meanwhile, cold weather is losing its intensity in the southern region.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 중부 11개 주에 걸쳐 상대습도가 12%까지 떨어지는 주황색 경보가 발효 중입니다. 가뭄 상황은 광범위한 지역에 영향을 미치고 있습니다. 남부 지역에서는 기온이 올라 추위가 점차 약해지고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Cold eases in the South as drought persists in central Brazil
items.title_ko: 남부에서는 추위가 약해지고 중부에서는 가뭄이 지속됩니다
items.title_original: Frio perde intensidade no Sul e seca persiste no centro do país

items.raw_excerpt: Essendon has named Mark McVeigh as senior coach one day after a 10-point loss and worst season in club history.
items.summary_en: Essendon Football Club named Mark McVeigh as its new senior coach. The announcement came one day after the club finished its worst season in history with a 10-point loss.
items.summary_ko: 에센든 AFC는 마크 맥비를 새로운 시니어 코치로 선임했다. 클럽 역사상 최악의 시즌을 보낸 뒤 10점 차 패배를 기록한 다음 날 발표가 이뤄졌다.
items.title_en: Essendon Appoints Mark McVeigh as Senior Coach
items.title_ko: 에센든, 마크 맥비를 시니어 코치로 선임
items.title_original: Swan's assistant takes-over as Essendon coach

items.raw_excerpt: Privacy experts are raising concerns after a Winnipeg bar flagged a woman as a nationwide public safety concern through its ID scanning system, which led to her being denied entry to a Calgary Stampede venue in July.
items.summary_en: A Winnipeg bar used an ID scanning system that flagged a woman as a nationwide public safety concern. She was later denied entry to a Calgary Stampede venue because of the flag. Privacy experts say the system raises serious concerns about how personal data is shared.
items.summary_ko: 위니펙의 한 바에서 사용하는 신분증 스캔 시스템이 한 여성에게 전국 안전 우려 대상이라는 표시를 남겼다. 이로 인해 그녀는 나중에 캘거리 스탬피드 행사장 입장이 거부됐다. 전문가들은 이 시스템이 개인정보 공유에 심각한 문제를 야기한다고 지적하고 있다.
items.title_en: Winnipeg bar ID scanner flags woman as nationwide safety concern
items.title_ko: 위니펙 바 신분증 스캔너가 여성에게 전국 안전 우려 표시
items.title_original: Woman flagged by ID scanner as nationwide 'public safety concern' after incident in Winnipeg bar

items.raw_excerpt: Both new and longstanding spaces provide vital opportunities for artists as government holds back support for the arts
items.summary_en: New and old cultural spaces in Buenos Aires are growing and helping local artists. The city government does not give much support to the arts. These centers give artists a place to create and share their work.
items.summary_ko: 부에노스아이레스에는 오래된 문화 공간과 새 문화 공간이 함께 생겨나고 있다. 시 정부는 예술 지원을 크게 하지 않는다. 하지만 이러한 센터들은 예술가들에게 창작과 발표의 기회를 제공한다.
items.title_en: Neighborhood cultural centers bloom despite state indifference
items.title_ko: 지역 문화센터, 정부 무관심 속에서도 꽃피다
items.title_original: Neighborhood cultural centers bloom despite state indifference

items.raw_excerpt: Thailand's first electronic rare coin auction on Monday featured a 10-baht circulation coin from 1990 that went under the hammer for 2.5 million baht.
items.summary_en: Thailand held its first electronic rare coin auction on Monday. A 10-baht circulation coin from 1990 sold for 2.5 million baht. The rare coin attracted strong interest from collectors across the country.
items.summary_ko: 태국에서 최초의 전자 희귀 동전 경매가 열렸다. 1990년 발행된 10바트 유통 동전이 250만바트에 팔려 화제가 됐다. 희귀 동전을 찾는 수집가들의 관심이 뜨거웠다.
items.title_en: Rare 10-Baht Coin Sells for 2.5 Million Baht in Thailand's First Online Auction
items.title_ko: 희귀 10바트 동전, 태국 첫 온라인 경매서 250만바트에 낙찰
items.title_original: Rare B10 coin sells for B2.5m in first online auction

items.summary_en: Sam Blaskowski, a 23-year-old American sprinter, wants to represent Poland using his family roots. His 100-metre time of 9.89 seconds would break the Polish national record. He plans to visit his ancestors' hometown in central Poland and hopes to race for Poland at next year's World Championships.
items.summary_ko: 23세 미국 단거리 선수 블라스코프스키가 가족 혈통을 근거로 폴란드 대표 전환을 추진 중이다. 그의 100미터 기록 9.89초는 폴란드 국가 기록을 경신하는 수준이다. 그는 폴란드 중부에 있는 선조의 고향을 방문하고 내년 세계 선수권에서 폴란드 대표로 출전할 계획이다.
items.title_en: US sprint star Sam Blaskowski wants to run for Poland
items.title_ko: 미국 단거리 스타 블라스코프스키, 폴란드 대표 전환 추진
items.title_original: Rising US sprint star Sam Blaskowski seeks to switch allegiance to Poland

items.raw_excerpt: CJP plans a protest march in Delhi on September 5, demanding the government fulfill unfulfilled promises to youth and protesters.
items.summary_en: The CJP has announced a protest march in Delhi on September 5, starting from India Gate. The group demands the government fulfill unfulfilled promises made to youth and protesters during previous demonstrations.

items.title_en: CJP calls for September 5 march from India Gate, accuses Centre of reneging on promises

items.raw_excerpt: While Benfica and Sporting CP spent much of the summer attracting attention with high-profile signings and squad reshaping, FC Porto has taken a very different approach.
items.summary_en: FC Porto has taken a different approach from rivals Benfica and Sporting CP this summer. While other clubs made high-profile signings, Porto focused on keeping their squad stable. The club believes stability could be their greatest strength.
items.summary_ko: FC 포르투는 이번 여름 라이벌 벤피카와 스포르팅 CP와는 다른 접근 방식을 택했습니다. 다른 클럽들이 화려한 영입에 집중할 때, 포르투는 팀 안정에 집중했습니다. 안정이 가장 큰 힘이 될 것이라고 믿고 있습니다.
items.title_en: FC Porto Chooses Stability Over Big Signings
items.title_ko: FC 포르투, 빅사이닝 대신 안정 선택
items.title_original: FC Porto's Familiar Formula: Why Stability Could Be the Dragons' Greatest Strength

items.raw_excerpt: William F. Baker and his wife have owned Henry Island for the past 35 years, but now at 84 years old he is considering selling the nearly 90-hectare island that is only reachable by boat.
items.summary_en: William Baker and his wife have owned Henry Island near Cape Breton, Nova Scotia for 35 years. At 84, Baker is thinking about selling the nearly 90-hectare island that is only reachable by boat. He describes the island as heaven.
items.summary_ko: 윌리엄 베이커와 부인은 35년간 뉴스코셔주 케이프 브레턴 근처 헨리 섬을 소유해 왔습니다. 84세인 베이커는 배로만 갈 수 있는 약 90헥타르 규모의 섬을 매각하는 것을 고려하고 있습니다. 그는 이 섬을 천국이라고 표현했습니다.
items.title_en: Elderly U.S. couple considers selling private island off Cape Breton coast
items.title_ko: 미국 노부부, 케이프 브레턴 해안의 사유지 섬 매각 검토
items.title_original: 'The whole island is heaven': U.S. couple considering parting ways with isle off Cape Breton’s coast

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay expands free bus travel for women to include Express, LSS, and Deluxe buses, effective October 2, 2026.
items.summary_en: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister announced that free bus travel for women will now include Express, LSS, and Deluxe buses. The expanded service starts on October 2, 2026. This builds on an existing program that has helped millions of women travel at no cost.
items.summary_ko: 타밀나두주 총리가 여성 대상 무상 버스 혜택을 일반·특급·디럭스 노선까지 확대한다고 발표했다. 확대 시행일은 2026년 10월 2일이다. 이는 이미 수백만 여성의 무상 이동을 지원해 온 기존 제도를 더욱 넓히는 조치이다.
items.title_en: Tamil Nadu expands free bus travel for women to more routes
items.title_ko: 타밀나두, 여성 무상 버스 혜택 확대
items.title_original: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay announces expansion of free bus travel for women in deluxe, mofussil buses

items.raw_excerpt: A woman has admitted an offence of breaching a lifetime ban on publishing information likely to lead to the identification of a victim of former DUP leader Jeffery Donaldson.
items.summary_en: An Irish woman admitted to breaking a lifetime court ban. She published details that could reveal the identity of a victim of former politician Jeffery Donaldson. The case was heard in an Irish court.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드의 한 여성이 종신 법원 명령을 어긴 혐의를 인정했다. 그녀는 전 정치인 제퍼리 도널드슨의 피해자 신분을 드러낼 수 있는 정보를 게시한 것으로 드러났다. 사건은 아일랜드 법원에서 심리되었다.
items.title_en: Woman admits breaking ban on naming abuse victim
items.title_ko: 도널드슨 피해자 신분 공개 금지 위반 인정한 여성

items.raw_excerpt: El referente de Universidad de Chile, que anunció su retiro para el final de la temporada, no sumó minutos en la derrota ante los "albos" y después del encuentro posó con un polémico lienzo.
items.summary_en: Chilean football star Marcelo Diaz announced his retirement at the end of the season. He did not play in the Superclasico match between Universidad de Chile and Colo-Colo. After the game, he posed with a controversial banner.

items.title_en: Marcelo Diaz had a special last Superclasico

items.raw_excerpt: Let's just say I wasn't as prepared as I thought I was...
items.summary_en: A person moved from the city to a small town in Ontario, hoping for a quieter life. They quickly found that small-town living was nothing like they imagined. The experience taught them that escaping the city comes with its own surprises.

items.raw_excerpt: In Germany, the supermarket you frequent says a lot about you, potentially revealing hints about your daily routine, diet and how much you're willing to splurge on bread or beer, writes Paul Krantz.
items.summary_en: The German supermarket you shop at reveals a lot about your daily routine, diet, and spending habits. From budget chains to premium stores, each choice hints at your lifestyle. A fun look at how Germans pick their grocery shops.
items.summary_ko: 독일에서 당신이 자주 찾는 슈퍼마켓은 일상 습관, 식습관, 지출 성향을 보여줍니다. 할인점부터 프리미엄 매장까지, 매장 선택은 라이프스타일을 드러냅니다. 독일인들의 장보기 취향을 재미있게 살펴봅니다.

items.summary_en: Austria's digital wallet now holds more than just driving licences. However, the usefulness of each digital document depends on the type, and some stop working once you leave Austria.

items.raw_excerpt: A shorter Ring Road comes with a new cost: Hornafjörður’s mayor wants the ISK 1,500 toll reviewed before charging begins September 1.
items.summary_en: The mayor of Hornafjörður wants to review a new ISK 1,500 toll on Iceland's Ring Road before it starts on September 1. The shorter route through the town would charge drivers each time they pass through.
